variants.paired: Current macOS, matched visible case at wide and narrow widths in Light and Dark.
variants.focus: Applicable keyboard focus and return, pointer hover, pressed, selected and disabled states.
variants.appearance: System appearance, custom theme and font, increased zoom, reduced motion, and an appearance change while open where applicable.
variants.native14: Repeat the native-sensitive case on the minimum supported macOS release.
variants.crossDesktop: Installed Windows 11 and Ubuntu 24.04 narrow and scaled layouts, focus, clipping and contrast.
variants.recovered: Compare initialized, imported and recovered profiles with the same fixture and ownership.
variants.timing: Measure the identical recorded fixture and host configuration before and after remediation.
